outgoing.name: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
outgoing.excerpt: Few took particular notice of the extinct bird until it became featured as a character in Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865).

outgoing.name: Carolus Linnaeus
outgoing.excerpt: The Mauritius Dodo (Raphus cucullatus, called Didus ineptus by Linnaeus), more commonly just dodo, was a metre-high (three-foot) flightless bird of the island of Mauritius.

outgoing.name: Fruit
outgoing.excerpt: The dodo, which is now extinct, lived on fruit and nested on the ground.

outgoing.name: Gerald Durrell
outgoing.excerpt: The Dodo is the symbol and mascot of the Durrell Wildlife Conservation Trust and the Jersey Zoological Park, founded by Gerald Durrell.
